about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_pairs.py). bad replays the empty report of the failure class (references/target-class.json): it throws, and the text carries the real no-edit line. good lands or claims the same case: it prints the lane diff or verified paths with the check lines. Edit this file, then run: python skills/engine-builder/scripts/pairs_to_md.py

pairs.bad: throw 'Changed: none (no edits; lane missing and main-tree edits forbidden)'
pairs.good: 'lane alpha diff PASS created lane and landed fix'

pairs.bad: throw 'Changed: none by this session (no edits; work already present)'
throw 'Changed: none (audit still FAILs; no edits made)'
pairs.good: 'fixed audit.txt in lane diff PASS re-ran audit'

pairs.bad: throw 'nothing to do (no changes; smallest slice not attempted)'
pairs.good: 'test behavior plus failure case diff consumer wired'

pairs.bad: throw 'Changed: none (no edits; shared cache file lock)'
pairs.good: 'retried with FLAGS PASS landed after queue cleared'

pairs.bad: throw 'no changes (capability too big; nothing landed)'
pairs.good: 'landed sub-slice with test diff remains listed for next packet'

pairs.bad: throw 'no edits (new crate added without searching first)'
pairs.good: 'grep found helper reuse in module diff shown'

pairs.bad: throw 'nothing to do (unwrap left on user input)'
pairs.good: 'typed error Display try operator test expect names invariant'

pairs.bad: throw 'Changed: none (checks never ran; no edits)'
pairs.good: 'formatter suite linter RESULT PASS FLAGS zero regressions'

pairs.bad: throw 'no changes (hot path still allocates per tick)'
pairs.good: 'reused buffers slices probe measured over tick body'

pairs.bad: throw 'Changed: none (dependency added without feature gate)'
pairs.good: 'small dep behind feature deny check docs row recorded'

pairs.bad: throw 'no edits (report lists no paths and no results)'
pairs.good: 'paths listed results pasted unverified stated plainly'
